title: 第19章 大概是老天爷赏饭吃
novel_title: 财神爷加好友！我被神仙团宠暴富(舒起起)
content_zh: 温栩栩听到林深云这话，眼皮都没抬一下。“我又不是蛆，怎么会想回你们林家那粪坑？”林深云被噎得一窒，脸色涨红：“粗鄙！”这时，质检的人到了。几个穿着工装的技术人员直奔那堆钢筋和水泥，取样、测量、比对，动作麻利。很快，领头那人抬起头，脸色凝重对周晋衍道：“周总，这批螺纹钢直径比国标小了2毫米，承重不达标。”“水泥也有问题。外排那几袋是好的，里头掺的这些，标号不够。”质检人员每说一句，周晋衍的脸色就沉一分。林深云的脸色则一寸寸变白。“这不可能！”林深云脱口而出，“我们林氏地产干了二十年，行业的口碑在这儿，从来没出过这种事！”周晋衍没看他。他只是摘下眼镜，缓缓擦了擦，又重新戴上。动作很慢，慢得让林深云屏住了呼吸，心惊肉跳。“林总。”周晋衍冷冷看向林深云：“你们工地先是克扣这位温小姐家属的工伤赔偿款，现在又查出材料质量不过关。”“我怎么放心把项目交给你？”林深云张了张嘴，一个字都说不出来。脑子里一团乱麻——他当初只是暗中授意赵大彪压着温屿的赔偿款，想让那丫头走投无路回来低头，怎么事情就闹到这个地步了？现在工地材料被查出问题，合作黄了，还要赔钱……到底是谁在背后搞鬼？他猛地看向温栩栩，眼神惊疑不定。是这丫头？不可能，她哪有这个本事。那是有人盯上他了？还是下面的人背着他……越想越乱，越想越慌。脸上还得撑着，不能露怯。林深云还想再争取，周晋衍却已经转身，对身后的助理淡淡吩咐：“和林氏地产的合作取消，重新找开发商。”“后续索赔事宜，让法务跟进。”林深云整个人像被抽空了似的，愣在原地。倒吸一口凉气——这个项目黄了，他至少得赔一千万！“周总！周总您听我说——”林深云追上去，声音都变了调，“这事儿我一定查清楚！给我点时间，我肯定给您一个交代！”周晋衍没理他。他脚步顿了顿，目光落在温栩栩身上，语气温和下来：“温小姐，工伤赔偿的事，我替工地先垫付。一百万，明天打到你哥收款账户。”温栩栩愣了一下，随即弯了弯眼睛：“周总，您说奇不奇怪，认识不到一小时的人，比某个自称是亲爹的，靠谱多了！”周晋衍被她逗笑了，金丝眼镜后面的眼睛里带上一丝兴味：“温小姐，我倒是很好奇——”“你是怎么看出这批材料有问题的？”温栩栩眨了眨眼，早就想好了说辞：“我这个人吧，眼睛比较尖。平时买东西，真假一眼就能看出来。”她想了想，一本正经地补充：“大概是老天爷赏饭吃。”周晋衍眼里的笑意更深了。他从大衣内袋里取出一张名片，烫金的边缘在阳光下微微一闪，递到温栩栩面前：“温小姐，期待日后有机会合作。”身后的助理瞳孔微震。他跟了周总五年，见过无数人递名片求见一面，却从没见过周总主动递名片给任何人。更别说对方还是个大学生。林深云在一旁看呆了。那张名片他认得。周晋衍的私人名片，没有公开电话，没有公司地址，只有一个名字和一串号码。圈子里的人都知道，拿到这张名片，就等于拿到了周晋衍的人脉。林深云做梦都想收到的名片，现在正被周晋衍亲手递给他嫌弃的女儿温栩栩。而温栩栩接过名片，低头看了一眼，随手揣进口袋里，语气稀松平常：“谢谢周总。”随后，她眼珠转了转，从包里翻出一支中性笔，直接在刚才买奶茶的购物小票背面，刷刷刷写下一串数字，递过去：“周总，你以后如果有什么鉴别真假的需要，欢迎找我！”林深云在一旁嘴角抽搐。人家周总什么样的专家大师不认识？还能找上这个黄毛丫头？那张购物小票皱巴巴的，边角还沾着一点奶茶渍，就这么被她当成了“名片”递出去。然而下一刻，周晋衍很爽快地接了。助理张了张嘴，欲言又止。周晋衍低头看了一眼那张皱巴巴的小票，上面还印着“珍珠奶茶·三分糖·加椰果”。他眼里的笑意更深了，把那小票叠好，收进大衣内袋。“好。”他说，“我记住了。”周晋衍推了推金丝眼镜，转身离去。温栩栩也拉着哥哥往自已车的方向走。林深云站在原地愣了两秒，忽然追上去两步：“温栩栩！”温栩栩脚步顿了顿，回头看他。林深云压着火，声音却掩不住那股憋屈：“你发现材料有问题，为什么不私下跟我说？这好歹是咱们林家的产业，咱们是一家人，你发现了先告诉我，内部及时处理不行吗？”“非要当着周总的面闹成这样？”温栩栩听完，歪了歪头，眼神无辜：“我说了，你会信吗？”林深云一噎。温栩栩继续说，语气轻飘飘的：“我说是林念薇陷害我偷东西，你信了吗？”她笑了笑：“所以我和你，没什么好说的。”温栩栩做了个鬼脸，拉着哥哥离开，顺便请几个帮过他们兄妹俩的工友吃饭发个感谢红包。她已经和周晋衍谈好了，以后这几个工友在工地就是铁饭碗，再也不用愁没活接、没人撑腰了！*晚上，林家别墅。林深云刚进门，林念薇就迎了上来，脸上带着期待：“爸，今天和周总谈得怎么样？他对咱们的项目还满意吗？”她还指望着能借这个项目跟周晋衍搭上线，以后进娱乐圈也好多条人脉。林母也端着茶杯走过来，一看他的脸色，眉头皱了皱：“怎么了这是？脸色这么差？”
content_en: When Wen Xuxu heard Lin Shenyun's words, she didn't even raise her eyelids."I'm not a maggot, why would I want to go back to the cesspit of your Lin family?" Lin Shenyun choked and his face turned red: "Vulgar!" At this time, the quality inspection personnel arrived.Several technicians in work clothes went straight to the pile of steel bars and cement, taking samples, measuring, and comparing them quickly.Soon, the leader raised his head and said to Zhou Jinyan solemnly: "Mr. Zhou, the diameter of this batch of rebar is 2 millimeters smaller than the national standard, and the load-bearing capacity does not meet the standard." "There is also a problem with the cement. The bags outside are good, but the ones inside are not labeled enough." Every time the quality inspector said something, Zhou Jinyan's face darkened.Lin Shenyun's face turned white inch by inch."This is impossible!" Lin Shenyun blurted out, "We, Lin's Real Estate, have been working in the real estate industry for twenty years, and our industry's reputation is here. This kind of thing has never happened before!" Zhou Jinyan did not look at him.He just took off his glasses, wiped them slowly, and put them back on.The movement was very slow, so slow that Lin Shenyun held his breath and his heart skipped a beat."Mr. Lin." Zhou Jinyan looked at Lin Shenyun coldly: "First, your construction site withheld the work-related injury compensation from Ms. Wen's family, and now it is found that the quality of the materials is not up to standard." "How can I trust you to hand over the project to you?" Lin Shenyun opened his mouth, but could not say a word.His mind was in a mess - he had only secretly instructed Zhao Dabiao to suppress Wen Yu's compensation, hoping that the girl would come back and bow her head when she was desperate. How did things get to this point?Now that the materials at the construction site have been found to be defective, the cooperation has been compromised, and money has to be lost... Who is behind this?He suddenly looked at Wen Xuxu with surprise and uncertainty in his eyes.Is it this girl?Impossible, she has no such ability.Was someone targeting him?Or was it the people below who were carrying him... The more he thought about it, the more confused he became, and the more he thought about it, the more panicked he became.You have to keep your face straight and not show any timidity.Lin Shenyun still wanted to fight for it again, but Zhou Jinyan had already turned around and told the assistant behind him calmly: "Cancel the cooperation with Lin's Real Estate and find a new developer." "Let the legal department follow up on the follow-up claims." Lin Shenyun seemed to have been evacuated and froze in place.Take a breath of cold air - this project is corrupt, he has to pay at least 10 million!"Mr. Zhou! Mr. Zhou, listen to me -" Lin Shenyun caught up with him, his voice changing tone, "I will definitely find out about this matter! Give me some time, and I will definitely give you an explanation!" Zhou Jinyan ignored him.He paused, looked at Wen Xuxu, and softened his tone: "Ms. Wen, for the work-related injury compensation, I will advance it on behalf of the construction site. One million will be paid to your brother's collection account tomorrow." Wen Xuxu was stunned for a moment, then rolled his eyes: "Mr. Zhou, is it strange that someone who has known him for less than an hour is much more reliable than someone who claims to be his biological father!" Zhou Jinyan was amused by her, wearing gold-rimmed glasses.There was a hint of interest in the back of her eyes: "Ms. Wen, I'm very curious -" "How did you tell that there was something wrong with this batch of materials?" Wen Xuxu blinked and had already thought of her words: "I am a person with sharp eyes. I can tell the authenticity of things at a glance." She thought for a while and added seriously: "It's probably God's reward." The smile in Zhou Jinyan's eyes deepened.He took out a business card from the inner pocket of his coat, its gilded edges flashing slightly in the sunlight, and handed it to Wen Xuxu: "Ms. Wen, I look forward to having the opportunity to cooperate in the future." The assistant behind him had slightly trembling pupils.He has followed Mr. Zhou for five years and has seen countless people hand over business cards asking for a meeting, but he has never seen Mr. Zhou take the initiative to hand out business cards to anyone.Not to mention that the other party is still a college student.Lin Shenyun looked on blankly.He recognized that business card.Zhou Jinyan's personal business card has no public phone number, no company address, only a name and a series of numbers.Everyone in the circle knows that getting this business card is equivalent to getting Zhou Jinyan's connections.The business card that Lin Shenyun had always dreamed of receiving was now being handed to his despised daughter Wen Xuxu by Zhou Jinyan himself.Wen Xuxu took the business card, glanced down, put it into her pocket, and said in a normal tone: "Thank you, Mr. Zhou." Then, she rolled her eyes, took out a gel pen from her bag, wrote down a series of numbers on the back of the shopping receipt for the milk tea she just bought, and handed it over: "Mr. Zhou, if you need to identify authenticity in the future, you are welcome to come to me!" Lin Shenyun's mouth twitched at the side.What kind of experts and masters does Mr. Zhou not know?Can we still find this yellow-haired girl?The shopping receipt was crumpled, with a little milk tea stain on the corner, so she handed it out as a "business card".However, the next moment, Zhou Jinyan readily accepted it.The assistant opened his mouth but stopped talking.Zhou Jinyan lowered his head and glanced at the crumpled receipt, which had "Pearl milk tea·three-point sugar·added coconut" printed on it.The smile in his eyes deepened, he folded the small ticket and put it into the inner pocket of his coat."Okay." He said, "I remember." Zhou Jinyan pushed up his gold-rimmed glasses and turned to leave.Wen Xuxu also pulled his brother in the direction of his car.Lin Shenyun stood there stunned for two seconds, then suddenly caught up with him two steps: "Wen Xuxu!" Wen Xuxu paused and looked back at him.Lin Shenyun suppressed his anger, but his voice could not conceal the aggrievedness: "You found something wrong with the materials, why didn't you tell me privately? This is our Lin family's property after all, and we are a family. If you find out, tell me first and deal with it internally in a timely manner?" "Do you have to make such a fuss in front of Mr. Zhou?" After hearing this, Wen Xuxu tilted her head with innocent eyes: "I told you, would you believe it?" Lin Shenyun choked.Wen Xuxu continued in a light tone: "I said Lin Nianwei framed me for stealing. Do you believe it?" She smiled: "So you and I have nothing to say." Wen Xuxu made a face, pulled her brother away, and invited a few workers who had helped the brother and sister to have a meal and give them red envelopes of thanks.She has already reached an agreement with Zhou Jinyan. From now on, these workers will be their iron breadwinners at the construction site, and they will no longer have to worry about being out of work or having no one to support them!*Night, Lin’s villa.As soon as Lin Shenyun walked in, Lin Nianwei came up to her with expectation on her face: "Dad, how was your talk with Mr. Zhou today? Is he satisfied with our project?" She also hoped that through this project, she could connect with Zhou Jinyan, and she would have many connections in the entertainment industry in the future.Mother Lin also came over with a tea cup. When she saw his face, she frowned: "What's wrong? You look so bad?"
